_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see applyMenuRelocations in main.js). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it, a child group targeting its own parent flattens). sections: menu-entry id -> section name (assigns a top-level leaf to a navigation section — `settings` renders it inside the NC gear-icon foldout, so genuinely-admin/config entries live under Settings instead of a duplicate top-level Administration group). removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links and e2e specs. Lives outside manifest.json because the app-manifest-v2 schema has additionalProperties:false at the root.

sections._note: AvgRequests (AVG/DSAR) and MdmDataQuality/MdmDuplicates are placed under Settings now, but are EARMARKED to move out of pipelinq later: AVG-verzoeken -> OpenRegister's AVG/DSAR subsystem (admin-gated, different data model — a prior seam found pipelinq cannot cleanly consume it yet), and DataQuality+Duplicates -> the OR-MDM abstraction (not built yet). Kept in pipelinq under Settings until those OR seams land.
